guidance.001:
ℹ️ {0}

🎤 Text ya voice note — dono chalte hain.
• Poori command list: "help"
• Step-by-step guide: "guide"
• Kisi bhi waqt dobara poochne ke liye: "kya karun"
guidance.002: Setup shuru karne ke liye "start" likhein.
guidance.003: Apni zubaan chunein: Roman Urdu, English ya اردو (neeche buttons hain).
guidance.004: Chunein: "Setup shuru karein", "Guide dekhein" ya "Purana data" (purane system se customers/products laane ke liye).
guidance.005: Barae meherbani apni dukaan ka naam likhein, maslan "Ayesha Collections".
guidance.006: Apni dukaan ki qism chunein (neeche list mein tap karein), ya likhein: kiryana, kapray, cosmetics, electronics, food, hardware.
guidance.007: Shehar, karobar ki qisam aur Instagram handle ek saath bhejein, jaise "Lahore, Clothing, @ayesha.collections" — ya "skip" likhein.
guidance.008: Batayein aapke paas kitne products hain: "10 ke qareeb", ya button dabayein.
guidance.product.add: Har product ka naam aur price bhejein, jaise "{0}" (kai products ek saath bhi, har line mein ek). Agar sirf naam likha ho to main price daryaft kar loon ga. Mukammal hone par "done" likhein.
guidance.009: Order confirm karne ke liye YES likhein. Tabdeeli ke liye likhein: "delivery 300", "advance 500". Rokne ke liye "cancel" likhein.
guidance.010: Order ki baqi detail bhejein ({0}). Rokne ke liye "cancel".
guidance.011: Sab orders confirm karne ke liye YES, ya sirf ek ka number bhejein.
guidance.012: Upar diye options mein se number bhejein (1 ya 2) — bolte waqt "pehla" / "dusra" bhi chalta hai.
guidance.013: YES ya NO likhein (bol kar "haan" / "nahi" bhi chalta hai).
guidance.014: Aapki voice se jo actions samjhe, woh upar likhe hain — chalane ke liye YES, rokne ke liye NO.
guidance.015: Discount code likhein, jaise "create discount: EID10, 10 percent, expires 15 days".
guidance.016: Payment method likhein, jaise "add payment: jazzcash, 0300-1234567".
guidance.017: Bot aapke jawab ka muntazir hai. Barae meherbani upar diye gaye sawal ka jawab dein, ya "cancel" likh kar rok dein.
